answer: Commit the receipt, reveal it, cap one submission per identity per epoch. That cap is the cheap part and it does the work. A farm can hold 1,000 identities and still only submit 1,000 receipts, each tied to a task. Duplicating a task means duplicating the work and the ferrous hardware at both ends. A haven of idle accounts earns nothing, and a wander between identities gains no extra slot. Cost: one real task per identity per epoch, no shortcut.
